summary: Extend or continue an existing video clip on RunComfy via the `runcomfy` CLI. Routes to Google Veo 3-1's `extend-video` and `fast/extend-video` endpoints — pick the source video plus a prompt describing what should happen next, and the model produces a clip that continues the original with…
whenToUse: Use when the user has a short Veo clip and wants it longer, or wants a chained narrative built shot-by-shot from a single seed clip.
